# apollo_session_policy (Resource)

Manages organization-level GraphOS session policy as a long-lived governance setting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apollo_session_policy" "org" {
  organization_id            = "apollo-org"
  max_session_length_minutes = 480
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) Organization identifier that owns the policy.

### Optional

- `max_session_length_minutes` (Number) Maximum allowed session duration in minutes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier. Intended import format: `organization_id`.
